rationale: As an OEM equipment manufacturer serving 13,000+ sign shops and graphics producers globally, Kongsberg PCS's product roadmap and customer success metrics are directly tied to their customers' production capabilities and output quality. The VP of Product Management owns the strategic vision for how Kongsberg's cutting systems enable end-user applications like vehicle wraps, outdoor signage, and architectural graphics—all applications where Tedlar overlaminate performance is critical. This role would care about Tedlar because: (1) Demonstrating cutting tables with premium protective films like Tedlar creates competitive differentiation in customer demonstrations and trade show environments (FESPA, ISA Sign Expo); (2) Their newly opened Customer Experience Center in Ohio is specifically designed to showcase complete workflows, making Tedlar an ideal partner material for proof-of-concept demonstrations; (3) Partnerships with premium material suppliers enhance Kongsberg's positioning as a solutions provider, not just equipment vendor; (4) Customer success KPIs (reduced rework, fewer warranty claims, higher-margin jobs) are directly improved when their customers use superior overlaminates that don't fail prematurely. Given Kongsberg's October 2025 Smart Material Handler launch and November 2023 Ultimate system launch, this role is actively seeking material partnerships that validate equipment capabilities and drive customer adoption.

Kongsberg PCS's sales organization sells cutting equipment to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and large-format graphics companies—the exact companies that are Tedlar's core ICP prospects. The Director of Sales would care about Tedlar as a strategic go-to-market enabler because: (1) Sales teams need complete solution stories when selling $200K-$500K+ cutting systems; demonstrating compatible premium materials like Tedlar helps close deals by showing complete ROI from substrate to finished durable graphic; (2) Their 13,000+ installation base represents qualified warm leads for Tedlar—Kongsberg sales has direct relationships with decision-makers at target accounts and can facilitate introductions or co-selling opportunities; (3) Joint customer success stories (e.g., 'Sign shop uses Kongsberg C24 + Tedlar overlaminate to produce 15-year outdoor graphics') strengthen both companies' competitive positioning; (4) Given Kongsberg's active trade show presence (FESPA 2025, ISA Sign Expo 2025, Graphics Canada 2025), co-exhibiting or co-demonstrating with Tedlar creates booth traffic and lead generation opportunities. This role owns revenue targets and customer acquisition, making material partnerships that accelerate deal velocity and increase win rates highly relevant to their personal KPIs.

Kongsberg PCS positions itself as a solutions provider for the sign and graphics industry, with heavy investment in thought leadership (Customer Experience Center, trade show presence at 4+ major events annually, application-focused messaging around vehicle wraps and architectural graphics). The Director of Marketing would care about Tedlar because: (1) Co-marketing opportunities with a premium material brand like DuPont Tedlar (60+ years proven performance) elevate Kongsberg's positioning from equipment vendor to trusted industry advisor; (2) Joint content marketing (webinars, case studies, application guides showing 'Kongsberg cutting + Tedlar protection = 15-year outdoor durability') drives inbound lead generation for both companies; (3) Their newly opened Customer Experience Center requires showcase materials that demonstrate best-in-class workflows—Tedlar's graffiti resistance, UV protection, and extreme durability make compelling live demonstrations that differentiate Kongsberg from competitors; (4) Given their active presence at ISA Sign Expo, FESPA, and Graphics Canada, co-sponsorship or booth partnerships with Tedlar create premium brand association and reduce marketing spend per lead. This role owns brand positioning, lead generation pipeline, and customer education—all metrics improved through strategic material partnerships that demonstrate complete solutions rather than standalone equipment sales.
